breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble. It first defined a standard convention for periodic grids on [a,b) (Nx points, dx=(b-a)/Nx) but then added a conflicting instruction for this specific task ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)'). The ground truth resolves this by removing the single contradictory sentence. The agent correctly resolved the ambiguity by omitting the entire confusing preamble and directly stating the correct, consistent grid definition for the periodic domain: 'Use Nx = 1024 grid points on [0, 1) with no duplicated endpoint. Set dx = 1.0 / Nx.'
